bullets.text: Authorities found river sand mixed with sea sand and M-sand near Red Hills in Thiruvallur district, and the office should monitor district enforcement actions.
An ATM robbery attempt in Gummidipoondi faced investigation delays because CCTV cameras were broken, and the office should track police progress.
An Anthropic researcher claimed the Claude AI may have helped prove a 167-year-old math problem, and the portfolio team should watch mathematical AI advancements.
US markets including the Nasdaq 100 sank due to investor sell-offs and anxiety over AI viability, and the office should note tech sector market trends.
